independence.scope: Repository preparation sources, historical AB06 report, current operational bundles, newly independent Codex provenance and functional-joint geometry only. Root has begun an isolated rebuild concurrently; this review invokes no build or native computation.

pipeline_order.contract: Immutable own raw healthy model and explicitly named static/dynamic trials; assert discovered sessions AB06 10_09_18 and AB07 10_14_18. Builder chooses first sorted session if multiple exist.

Same captured AB06 PI321/500 donor, AB06 healthy fit reference, saved AB06 static ground reference, fixed STL and binary plane bytes for both. freeze_preparation_references snapshots donor/healthy/static before conversion, once per invocation; compare snapshot hashes across invocations.

Own biological components outside the replaced left chain and subject hip retained; fixed donor hardware and SEA semantics. Ratios of healthy femur-scale/shank length change only two mount Y coordinates. Total own mass preserved by benchmark redistribution; donor COM and proportional inertia retained.

Match donor-relative median fixed-STL clearance and sagittal inclination; change only distal mount Y and static calibration ankle pose. Preserve axes, joint defaults/ranges, dynamic commands, source IK and profiles. This target is a benchmark convention, not a measured floor.

Same 12 left markers, stride 1 and full overlapping static samples; average measured world coordinates transformed into each current body frame. Other markers preserved. Freely calibrated anatomical marker coordinates may absorb changed mounting and joint geometry.

Solve against newly calibrated model and full converted dynamic TRC. Dataset-remapped IK only supplies range/static calibration; it cannot substitute for the fresh output. Bundle uses the new solver motion/model as one matched pair.
Validate hashes, whitelists, full acquisition coverage and finite complete coordinates before saved-data comparisons; no operational promotion or dynamics implied by build status complete.

IK_flags_independently_verified.full_time_range: Entire original dynamic acquisition, not nine-second setup crop
IK_flags_independently_verified.ScaleTool: Skipped automatically because model equals marker_set; explicit force-scaling prohibited
IK_flags_independently_verified.fresh_output_guard: IK-only runner removes only its own previous full-IK outputs before executing, preventing successful-command reuse

posthoc_production_filter.derivative: CubicSpline derivative, not finite difference of rounded STO

profile_fixed_contract.qualification_scope: Shared AB06-derived empirical profile is a separate contact-generalization assumption; same preparation does not validate it physically.

legacy_confounds.finding: AB06 and AB07 historical preparation stages differ
legacy_confounds.evidence: May 12 daily records AB06 marker-calibrated mass-preserved model and real full-span OpenSim marker IK, rejecting RRA. Current AB07 receipt records anatomical fit, donor-relative ground registration, static marker refit and new marker IK.
legacy_confounds.implication: AB06 is not a remapped-dataset fallback; a matched current rebuild controls procedural asymmetry prospectively.

legacy_confounds.finding: AB06 identity fit is reference anchoring
legacy_confounds.evidence: Subject and healthy reference are AB06, so upper/shank ratios equal one and existing donor mounts remain the baseline.
legacy_confounds.implication: The same current code on both does not independently qualify the donor ankle-center convention or make AB06 anatomically unbiased.

legacy_confounds.finding: Static clock historical mismatch is documented
legacy_confounds.evidence: Legacy AB06 converted static uses 400 rows at 10 ms (0–3.990 s); prior row-matched raw audit records original Header 5 ms (0–1.995 s). Current converter uses Header first.
legacy_confounds.implication: Verify rowwise marker/pose parity and new clocks. Geometry registration uses pose medians without velocity; an affine clock dilation shared by IK and markers is not itself a demonstrated dynamic force cause. A direct attempt using the strict dynamic MAT decoder rejected the static FileWrapper schema; no independent static clock validation is claimed by that attempt.

legacy_confounds.finding: Biological anatomy is only partly retained
legacy_confounds.evidence: Own seven healthy bodies/unaffected joints and remapped hip are preserved, with 49 own muscles plus 27 donor muscles in both; left healthy bodies and subtalar/MTP mechanism are intentionally replaced.
legacy_confounds.implication: Same prep preserves raw inputs and retained biological anatomy, not the entire original left anatomy or subject-specific donor muscle geometry.

legacy_confounds.evidence: 12 remapped marker positions are free averages from the same static poses used for calibration; no static measured GRF available.
legacy_confounds.implication: Small calibration residual does not certify physical ankle center, hardware sole placement or contact-law accuracy.

legacy_confounds.finding: Solver backend is selected by environment unless explicitly pinned
legacy_confounds.evidence: Builder optionally forwards --opensim-cmd; IK runner otherwise selects native CLI if discovered, or Python OpenSim fallback.
legacy_confounds.implication: Record same actual backend, OpenSim/MATLAB/Python versions, plugin and solver flags for both rebuilds; a shared argv alone is insufficient if environment changes.

geometry_review.point: Parent joint-socket origin, validated equal to child socket and childbody origin at every pose: healthy ankle_l/talus_l versus prepared pros_ankle/foot_l. Healthy calcn_l origin remains an explicitly nonhomologous annotation.
geometry_review.axis: Healthy oblique CustomJoint axis [.10501355,.17402245,.97912632] versus prepared PinJoint Z; unit and positive rotation validated, never treated as identical axes.
geometry_review.motion: Own full filtered original healthy 23-coordinate MAT versus own full filtered prepared 21-coordinate marker IK on identical within-subject frozen windows.
geometry_review.interpretation: Exact geometric before/after response at each own subject motion, not anatomy-only/preparation-only causal shares, physical marker equivalence, or sole/contact-depth equivalence. Both prepared centers rise versus their own healthy centers; AB06 rises more. Differential lowering of AB07 relative AB06 does not mean AB07 was uniformly moved downward relative its own healthy center.

effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.label: verified construction effect
effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.required: Consistent before/after model+whole-IK response at fixed raw data, shared profile, stated coordinates, grids and source hashes.
effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.allowed_claim: This preparation/reference procedure changes the tested geometric or contact response by the reported conditional amount.
effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.forbidden_claim: That amount is an error, anatomy share, or causal percentage of the observed rollout discrepancy.

effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.label: implementation or preparation error
effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.required: Concrete violation of declared specification/invariant or independently checked unit, frame, clock, force mapping, axis, model/IK provenance or solver coverage.
effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.allowed_claim: A specific preparation fault is demonstrated, with its checked effect and scope.
effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.forbidden_claim: Any nonzero healthy-to-prosthetic geometry difference automatically proves a fault.

effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.label: physical geometric error
effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.required: Independent ground/hardware/joint-center reference with known frame and uncertainty, not marker positions freely fit to the same calibration poses or the donor convention itself.
effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.allowed_claim: The prepared geometry differs from independent physical evidence beyond the stated uncertainty.
effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.forbidden_claim: In-sample marker RMS or donor groundfit residual validates physical placement.

effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.label: anatomical causal attribution
effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.required: Specify intervention preserving acquisition/gait/reference, preparation recipe, solver and contact assumptions; validate meaningful model/motion combinations. Own-subject healthy B−A alone combines anatomy, gait and IK.
effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.allowed_claim: Conditional geometric anatomy sensitivity under the explicit intervention; dynamic causal effect only after an separately authorized valid dynamic experiment.
effect_vs_actual_error_criteria.forbidden_claim: Residual B−A after same-code rebuilding equals pure anatomy; crossed model/pose hybrids are physically valid rollouts.

postbuild_discriminator_predeclared.first: Compare old/current versus newly common-prepared full model+IK within each subject on unchanged raw trial and frozen measured primary cycles. Report both own changes and change in between-subject contrast, including geometry and fixed-profile FK contact; do not compare unmatched geometry-only/IK-only diagonals as validated bundles.
postbuild_discriminator_predeclared.second: Use independent or withheld static/dynamic marker evidence and hardware/floor measurements to distinguish procedure effect from physical error. Withheld frames qualify residual generalization; markers remapped freely still do not independently identify hardware contact geometry.
postbuild_discriminator_predeclared.meaning_of_unchanged_outputs: Evidence the legacy/current procedural distinction has little effect under this donor-anchored recipe, not proof anatomy is the exclusive remaining cause.
postbuild_discriminator_predeclared.meaning_of_changed_outputs: Evidence of end-to-end recipe sensitivity under the fixed benchmark, not total preparation error or causal share.
postbuild_discriminator_predeclared.no_profile_fit: No fitting contact gains, sphere positions, plane offsets or BW scaling to GRF is part of this discriminator.

provenance_review_correction.draft_problem: GeometryPath serialization name and ordering of Appearance/PathPointSet/PathWrapSet caused physical-identical muscles to be misclassified.
provenance_review_correction.resolution: Only GeometryPath component name and its three property order normalized; path-point and wrap ordering plus every numerical muscle property remain compared. Independent stdlib XML check reproduces 49 own+27 donor, zero unclassified in both. Superseded drafts are not evidence.
